name: e2e
description: Browser E2E tests for packages/pleiades-widget against a real (headless) browser — bun:test has no DOM, so the widget's own suite can only exercise WebMcpProvider through fakes, never the real navigator.modelContext detection/wiring path. Deliberately not part of `bun run test` (needs `bunx playwright install chromium` once, a real browser download — same reasoning as test:beta-text).
